svg.text: Clara and the First Beautiful Pokemon — p11
PLACEHOLDER · characters: clara, pip, moxie · seed: None

text.tspan: Close-up. The crystal moth with all four rainbow wings fully
open, glowing softly, perched gently on Clara's open palm.
Clara's other hand hovers near, not touching. A single happy
tear sparkles on Clara's cheek, big tooth-gap smile. Pip nearby,
flame-tuft glowing soft orange. Characters: CLARA: 5-year-old
human girl, short and round, fair white skin with pink cheeks,
long honey-blonde hair to mid-back with straight-across blunt
bangs, huge sparkling blue eyes, big tooth-gap grin, glittery
pink hair bow on the right side, red and white pokeball-print
hoodie, denim shorts, red sneakers, sticky-berry satchel across
chest, big-eyed bright Pokemon-anime cel-shaded style, default
expression is a giant bossy smile with one hand on hip | PIP:
tiny round fire-mouse pokemon, fluffball the size of Clara's
hand, soft cream-orange fur with cream belly, huge round black
